name: Euro
source: Exchange rate: Deutsche Bundesbank, DM per US dollar (Frankfurt fixing, converted at 1.95583 DM per euro) until 1998, ECB euro reference rate from 1999; last quote of each month, every daily fixing for the SMA signal. Euro short rate: 3-month money market rate for Germany (OECD via FRED IR3TIB01DEM156N), latest months carried forward. German inflation: OECD consumer price index (FRED DEUCPIALLMINMEI), after its last month the HICP (FRED CP0000DEM086NEST).
